summary:
On main 15e78e276 the pieces exist but they do not form an island. One shared FloatMenu (Note, Dialogue, Search, Deep-research) is mounted in four hosts: the Reading book reader, the Research /inv synthesis, the DRW block detail and the Write outline editor. Its lifetime is tied to the live DOM selection: FloatMenu returns null the moment useFloatMenuSelection reports no selection. I bundled the real hook into a harness with a FloatMenu-shaped host and ran it in Chromium (RUN, /tmp/mothership-ground/island-ask/harness/run.mjs). Clicking Dialogue mounts its autoFocus textarea, the focus collapses the document selection, and the panel unmounts: "menu = unmounted | #ta present = false". The Note and Edit panels use the same textarea pattern, so they are very likely unusable in Chrome. No e2e test covers this, and the jsdom unit tests cannot see it.

Deep-research from a highlight launches a real child research everywhere, but only /inv keeps it in place. There it opens a floating, draggable ChaseThread panel with a live ThinkingStream, placed at a fixed cascade spot (120,120), not beside the selection. Reading's highlight path calls POST /books/{id}/spin-research and navigates away to /inv/:id. If that call fails, only console.error fires. A withheld selection is a silent no-op. The launch is also not recorded in the ReadingCompanion "Saved chases" list, which only ChaseThread fills, from localStorage. The DRW block detail navigates away with no try/catch. In Write, the "Spin a sub-agent" action spawns a child research and then throws away its id (Outline.tsx:605).

Dialogue is a one-shot /thought-partner call. It does not stream, is not persisted and is not anchored. Its prompt quotes the selection, and system_context adds the workspace and reading focus. Anchoring primitives that would support a durable island exist but nothing calls them: the chase-launcher and marginalia anchored-widget augmentations are used only in tests, RegionStore has no API, researches_for_passage and passage_for_research have no callers, and the Hybrid ask-first stub is off because no host passes the flag.

Asking without a highlight works through the AI sidecar (⌘/ from anywhere, or Ask in the Research scene bar), a multi-turn thought partner kept in sessionStorage. Context is attached through ContextPicker, which takes typed raw ids of kind @doc or @insight only and has no styling. Brainstorm adds drag-in insight slotting. There is no way to attach notes, prior threads or investigations, and no way to ask a completed thread a follow-up. The DRW redirect and deepen controls act only on running cascade researches.

The model dropdown works only in TalkToBook, which is book-level and not tied to a selection. The sidecar and Brainstorm dropdowns send model_choice, but ThoughtPartnerRequest drops it (RUN: its fields are history, investigation_id, prompt and system_context). PR #3278 would wire this, but it has been open since 2026-09-20 with vitest failing. Island launches cannot carry a model choice at all: SpinResearchRequest has no model field (RUN), and POST /investigations refuses a model choice on any child launch with owner_model_root_required (app.py:2742-2743). TalkToBook answers are stored server-side as read.book_answered events, but the UI never reads them back; it rebuilds the conversation from sessionStorage.

The artifact feedback docket (ArtifactFeedbackReview) is the closest thing to a persisted, anchored thread with a research agent. It is behind VITE_ANTIEK_FEEDBACK_ENABLED, which nothing sets, and it has no list endpoint to re-find threads. The design branches in flight (w1 and w3) only restyle FloatMenu and Reading; none of them build island behaviour.

capabilities.gap: The island's lifetime has to be separated from the transient DOM selection. Needed: an IslandStore (zustand: {islandId, anchor, docId, projectId, threadId, state}) that snapshots the selection when the island opens (text + Region + rect) and then renders independently of selectionchange. Only the four-button menu bar should stay bound to the live selection. Without this, Note, Dialogue and Edit are expected to be unusable in Chromium. Also needed: repositioning on scroll and resize (today the fixed rect goes stale), and a Playwright e2e test that highlights text, opens Dialogue, types and gets a reply in a real browser.
capabilities.backend_dependency: none for the lifetime fix; a durable anchor needs the Region write path (see IA-04)
capabilities.ux_notes: The menu is a dark ink pill with shadow-lg (blurred) and no enter or exit motion. Panel back control is a bare '←' glyph. Textareas use outline-none with no focus-visible replacement (FloatMenu.tsx:365,499, also flagged in the design baseline).

capabilities.name: Deep-research from a selection (child research launch)

capabilities.gap: Launch works, but the result is not an island. Reading and DRW take the user away. Write orphans the child. Reading records the link only at page granularity (passage_id = doc + page_index) under the synthetic parent 'read-spin', not the selected span. Needed: one launchFromSelection(selection, {projectId, docId, region}) API used by every host; it returns a thread id that the island renders in place, with a live stream, instead of navigating. Reading failures need a visible AIActionFailure. A withheld Deep-research needs the WITHHELD_OUTBOUND_REASON message, which Search already shows.

craft_gaps: The island dies on focus: in Chromium the Note and Dialogue panels unmount the moment their autoFocus textarea mounts (RUN harness). There is no designed 'island' state at all, only a transient menu.

FloatMenu has no enter or exit motion (design baseline full-audit-motion-interaction.md:100 lists FloatMenu as 'none'), uses a blurred shadow-lg (FloatMenu.tsx:189) against the spec's hard 5px offset for floating islands (DESIGN-SPEC.md:47), and puts a bare '←' glyph in the panel header (FloatMenu.tsx:614-621).

Sprint and internal language reaches users: 'One-shot reply (not a full chat) this sprint.' (FloatMenu.tsx:525), 'Hybrid — coming (AI asks first)' (FloatMenu.tsx:278), 'Saved — user-sourced, anchored to your selection.' (FloatMenu.tsx:353), 'Same thought partner as Surface E' (TalkToBook.tsx:330), and the dialogue 'shape' enum (CHALLENGE/SYNTHESIS) shown raw as a mono label (FloatMenu.tsx:487-491, AISidecar.tsx:448-450).
Text controls on island surfaces remove the outline with no focus-visible replacement: FloatMenu.tsx:365 and :499, TalkToBook.tsx:459 (SCORE-BASELINE-full.md:149).

AISidecar and ContextPicker are hand-rolled with native controls. ContextPicker has no CSS at all (class names only, grep finds none) and makes the user type raw document or insight ids. The AISidecar textarea has no background, so typed text is 1.13:1 at night (SCORE-BASELINE-full.md:188).

Hotkeys are incoherent: AISidecar's own ⌘J handler dispatches 'antiek:aisidecar:toggle', which has no production listener (AISidecar.tsx:190-196 and shortcuts.ts comment); ⌘/ is swallowed whenever focus is in any text field or contentEditable (shortcuts.ts:128-139), which covers the whole Write editor; 'AI sidecar ⌘J' collides with 'Research ⌘J' in the HUD (visual-critiques.md:1781).

Failure states are uneven: Reading highlight Deep-research fails silently (console.error, Reading/index.tsx:252); DRW BlockDetail throws an unhandled rejection (BlockDetail.tsx:55-68); a withheld Deep-research click does nothing with no message (Reading/index.tsx:245, HighlightToolbar.tsx:51), while Search shows the withheld reason.

No phone path: floating panels are not rendered below 768px (PanelLayout.tsx:90-103), so the highlight-to-chase island does not exist on narrow screens, and TalkToBook's fixed bottom sheet is the only narrow-screen ask.

Progress is text-only on the ask surfaces ('Asking…', 'Reading the book…'); only the /inv ChaseThread panel shows a live, narrated ThinkingStream. There is no token streaming anywhere on the thought-partner path.
Two separate 'Ask' verbs share the Research screen (the sidecar toggle in SceneChrome.tsx:75 and the composer submit); the Read and Write scenes have no Ask verb (visual-critiques.md:1657).
risks: The RUN finding (the selection collapses on textarea focus, so the panels unmount) comes from the real hook in a FloatMenu-shaped harness in Chromium only. The full FloatMenu inside the deployed app, and Firefox and Safari, are NOT MEASURED. The first step of any island work should be a Playwright e2e test in apps/reading/e2e that reproduces the harness against /read/:id and /inv/:id.
